title: 帝11章 圣器认主叶峰来迟第12章 谁给你的勇气
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: “我没看错吧？圣子这是要敲击万古钟来检测实力吗？”
“确实没看错！
不过我记得想要敲响万古钟，除了实力要强外，天赋才是最重要的。
可是我记得圣子的天赋一般啊，当初测试时应该只是下品吧？”
“下品天赋？那估计连万古钟一声都敲不响吧！”
广场周围不断传来弟子们的议论声。
不过对于这些，徐墨却是根本不在乎，脸上并没表现出丝毫怒色。
毕竟他们说的也是事实，若是前几天的徐墨，确实连万古钟一声都击不响。
可是，那只是之前！
现在的徐墨不仅融合了太阳圣体，更是修炼了九阳灭世诀此等攻击力极强的准帝级功法。
修为也达到了炼虚初期巅峰，此等修为和实力，将万古钟击出七响乃至八响都是绰绰有余！
徐墨摆好挥拳姿势，深呼一口气，将脑海中所有的杂念清除。
下一瞬，他猛地运转全身灵气，一股如太阳般炽热的气息从他周身喷涌而出，犹如风暴般将整个练武场笼罩。
“嗯？这股热浪是怎么回事？难不成是丹长老的炼丹炉炸了？”
众多弟子在感受到这股热浪的瞬间，脸上不由露出惊骇的神情，猜测道。
还未等他们过多思考。
砰！
一道滔天巨响，从万古钟所在区域传出。
徐墨挥舞右拳，重重地落在万古钟上！
霎时间，这股力道直接让万古钟剧烈的震动起来，接着一道道古老厚重的钟声瞬间响起！
咚～咚～咚～
“不是，我没听错吧？
圣子大人，竟然将万古钟击出了三响？”
“刚刚是哪个瞎了狗眼的人说，圣子大人一声都击不响的！
这下傻眼了吧！
脸打得啪啪的吧！”
“哎，你们的表现也太夸张了，不过是三响而已！
想当初我可是能击出四响的！”
在钟声的响起的瞬间，周围的弟子包括几个路过的长老都开始议论起来，现场一片嘈杂。
虽说击响万古钟三声并不算什么，且现场也有不少弟子能做到。
但是你别忘了，击响三声的人可是徐墨啊！
而且刚刚他们所有人可都认为他一响都击不出，这么一看的话，这三响确实是很不错的成绩了！
当然也仅仅只是不错而已，离优秀还差得远。
很快，众人的心情就平复了下来。
然后就在此时！
咚～咚～咚～
万古钟的钟身猛地一震，钟体上也显现出一道耀眼的金光，随后竟又是三声钟声响起！
而原来还嘈杂的练武场，也变得瞬间安静下来。
content_en:
"Am I right? Is the Holy Son going to strike the eternal bell to test his strength?"
"You read that right indeed!
But I remember that if you want to ring the eternal bell, in addition to being strong, talent is the most important thing.
But I remember that the Holy Son’s talent was average. It was probably just low-grade when he was first tested, right? "
"Low-grade talent? That probably won't even ring the bell of eternity!"
Discussions from the disciples continued to come from around the square.
However, Xu Mo didn't care about these at all, and did not show the slightest anger on his face.
After all, what they said was true. If it were Xu Mo a few days ago, he would indeed not be able to ring the eternal bell.
But, that was just before!
Now Xu Mo has not only integrated the Holy Body of the Sun, but has also practiced extremely powerful quasi-emperor-level techniques such as the Nine Yang World Destruction Technique.
His cultivation has also reached the peak of the early stage of Void Refining. This kind of cultivation and strength is more than enough to hit the Eternal Bell for seven or even eight times!
Xu Mo positioned his fist, took a deep breath, and cleared all the distracting thoughts from his mind.
The next moment, he suddenly circulated his spiritual energy, and a breath as hot as the sun spurted out from his body, covering the entire martial arts training ground like a storm.
"Huh? What's going on with this heat wave? Could it be that Elder Dan's alchemy furnace exploded?"
The moment many disciples felt this heat wave, they couldn't help but have horrified expressions on their faces and guessed.
Before they could think too much.
Bang!
A loud noise came from the area where the Eternal Bell was located.
Xu Mo waved his right fist and landed heavily on the Eternal Bell!
In an instant, this force directly caused the eternal bell to vibrate violently, and then a series of ancient and thick bells sounded instantly!
Boom ~ boom ~ boom ~
"No, did I hear it correctly?
The Holy Son actually struck the Eternal Bell three times? "
"Just now, some blind person said that the Holy Son couldn't even make a sound!
You're dumbfounded now!
His face was slapped! "
“Hey, your performance is too exaggerated, it’s just three rings!
I think I could hit four times back then! "
The moment the bell rang, the surrounding disciples, including several passing elders, began to talk, and the scene was noisy.
Although ringing the Eternal Bell three times is nothing, and there are many disciples on site who can do it.
But don’t forget, the person who rang the three bells was Xu Mo!
And just now all of them thought that he couldn't hit even one shot. If you look at it this way, these three shots are indeed a very good result!
Of course, it's just good, far from excellent.
Soon, everyone's mood calmed down.
And then right now!
Boom ~ boom ~ boom ~
The body of the Eternal Bell shook suddenly, and a dazzling golden light appeared on the bell body, and then three more bells rang!
The originally noisy martial arts training ground suddenly became quiet.
